meta.name: affiliate-program-search
meta.description: Research and evaluate affiliate programs to find the best ones to promote. Use this skill when the user asks anything about finding affiliate programs, comparing commission rates, evaluating affiliate opportunities, searching for products to promote, picking a niche, or mentions openaffiliate.dev. Also trigger for: "which SaaS should I promote", "best affiliate programs for X", "high commission programs", "recurring commission affiliate", "compare these affiliate programs", "is X affiliate program worth it", "find me something to promote", "what pays the most", "affiliate programs with long cookie duration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并比较联盟营销项目，找到最佳推广对象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望找到高佣金且可靠的联盟项目来推广
copy.tagline_en: Search and compare affiliate programs to find the best ones to promote
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to discover high-commission and reliable affiliate programs to promote

howto.what: 当用户询问推荐联盟计划时，Claude 会搜索 openaffiliate.dev 数据库，根据佣金、饼干时长等条件筛选并评分，给出前几名推荐及评分理由。
howto.when: 当用户提到“找联盟计划”、“比较佣金”、“推荐推广产品”、“哪个SaaS值得推广”、“openaffiliate.dev”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个适合推广的AI工具联盟计划

say.note: Claude 会拉取两者数据，做对比评分并推荐。

say.text: 我是新手，应该推广什么？
say.note: Claude 会按新手友好标准推荐门槛低的计划。

howto.what_en: When the user asks for affiliate program recommendations, Claude searches the openaffiliate.dev database, filters by commission, cookie duration, etc., scores programs on 5 dimensions, and presents a top pick with runner-up.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions finding affiliate programs, comparing commissions, recommending products, 'which SaaS to promote', or 'openaffiliate.dev'.

say_en.text: Find me an AI tool affiliate program to promote
say_en.note: Claude uses defaults (AI/SaaS, recurring 20%+) to search and recommend.

say_en.text: Compare HeyGen vs Synthesia affiliate programs
say_en.note: Claude fetches both, scores them, and gives a side-by-side comparison.

say_en.text: I'm a beginner, what should I promote?
